a.lede: PHP2Shell shows how quickly attackers can exploit critical vulnerabilities, often before organizations have time to patch. Token Security explains why limiting the access of service accounts, API keys, and AI agents is just as important as fixing vulnerabilities to reduce the damage from a breach. [...]
a.title: Even after PHP2Shell, blast radius matters more than a CVSS score

b.lede: The critical flaw in UEFI firmware—used by most server vendors and data centers—allows attackers to execute code early in the boot process.
b.title: Most Servers on the Planet Are Vulnerable to This Firmware Code-Execution Flaw
